fact: ANIP director Aristide Adjinacou says the single-desk pilot in ten health facilities registered over 13,000 births in six months (over 76%), with the aim that every child receive a personal identification number (NPI) and birth certificate in the first days of life.
Benin piloted from October 2025 a digital civil registration that issues a newborn a Personal Identification Number on registration, supported by UNICEF and WURI.
